$comment: Shared base for the dist-producing libs. Path options (outDir/declarationDir/rootDir/tsBuildInfoFile) and `include` MUST stay per-lib: `${configDir}` makes `@nx/js:tsc` silently emit nothing — the `dist` target still prints 'Done compiling' and exits 0, but no .js/.d.ts is written. Plain tsc handles it fine, so apps/tsconfig.apps.base.json can use it; the libs cannot, because their dist target runs through that executor. libs/skills does not extend this: its program includes apps/platform/config, outside any rootDir set here, and it emits via esbuild.
